name: Spartan Chosen
headerMeta: Golden era · Melee infantry · shields · 305 leadership · Seasonal (Sparta)
pitch: A heavily armored shield-wall anchor that thrives in blob and skirmish but crumbles to burst damage; its Oath of Unity trait spreads and mitigates incoming harm, making it the frontline unit that opens for your team's counterattack.

veterancy.label: Full Bot
veterancy.body: Nerfs guided this unit toward the Tank Line over the DPS line — consistent mitigation across all scenarios.

battleRole.positioning: Frontline anchor — hold the line and block ranged fire. Never hesitate to redirect and reposition before pressing ability 2, and activate CCi + X-move back if overextended. {1}
battleRole.tips: Ability 1 (No Mercy) redirects to your facing and stabs in front; each stab heals 5% HP. {1} Ability 2 (shield advance) requires re-pressing during the advance to stab; the 3rd press jumps forward with big damage. {1} Main trait (Oath of Unity): for 5s after using a spell, all damage taken spreads through the unit and is reduced to 70% (30% dmg reduction net). {1}

controls.notes: Master the double-C brace (ability 2 repress) for 3–4× area coverage with minimal DPS loss. {1} Play around cooldowns — Oath of Unity resets every 5s after a spell cast. {1}
